name: Separator
purpose: A horizontal or vertical line that divides groups of content a reader should take as separate. Use it sparingly, mainly in lists and menus.

notFor.when: The groups are better separated by their own surfaces.
The groups only need air between them.

basis.note: Behaviors come from the Notion UI SDK inventory (2026-11-21). The support tag on each one was checked against the source on the checked date. The inventory says the docs give no alternative component for this use; the notFor list comes from the Vois marketing rules.

anatomy.note: The single part. Place it between two groups. It has no sub parts.

behaviors.text: A screen reader announces a separator between the groups it divides.
behaviors.evidence: separator.tsx: a non decorative separator has role separator and, when vertical, aria-orientation vertical
behaviors.note: Horizontal is the default for the role, so aria-orientation is left off.

behaviors.text: A line that adds no information can be marked decorative. It gets no role and no orientation for assistive technology and is skipped.
behaviors.evidence: separator.tsx: decorative sets role none and drops aria-orientation
behaviors.note: Decorative is off by default in Radix. vois-separator turns it on by default, as shadcn does; set decorative to false when the line alone shows the division.

behaviors.text: A decorative separator keeps its orientation for styling.
behaviors.evidence: separator.tsx: data-orientation is set in both cases

behaviors.text: The separator can run horizontally or vertically. A bad value falls back to horizontal.
behaviors.evidence: separator.tsx: isValidOrientation falls back to horizontal

behaviors.text: A vertical separator takes the height of its row and stretches to the tallest item.
behaviors.note: Radix draws no line. Give it the size from CSS: for a vertical one, self stretch in a flex row, or an explicit height.

behaviors.text: A separator never takes focus, so Tab moves past it.
behaviors.evidence: separator.tsx: a div with no tabIndex and no handlers

behaviors.text: The line is drawn with a token color and a 1px thickness.
behaviors.note: Radix has no styles. vois-separator uses a 1px line in a border token.

mistakes.text: Do not mark a separator decorative unless the surrounding content already conveys the division.
Do not use a separator as a spacer. Use spacing tokens.
Do not add dividers to marketing pages. The marketing rules say none.
mistakes.note: vois-patterns marketing rules. The component stays for lists and menus.
